Font weighting reference

Short lead paragraph rendered directly in the body face.

Long running body copy that a reader actually consumes on the page: several sentences of continuous prose describing the product, its materials and the way it is delivered, all set in the body typeface rather than in the compact label face used by the badges.

A second block of continuous body copy, again long enough to outweigh every short label on the page, explaining shipping terms, returns and the warranty in the same reading typeface that the storefront uses for its ordinary paragraphs and list items.
